Alicia completed her Undergraduate and Master degrees in London, and is now a PhD student working on the role of monocyte-derived macrophages in the development of peritoneal adhesions. She is interested in looking at this in the context of post-operative adhesions and endometriosis. *Born in Spain, Alicia grew up abroad, moving to a new city every 3 years.*
